With international crises and the wars in the Middle East and Ukraine, the European Union's energy vulnerability is becoming increasingly apparent. Europe is looking for solutions and reliable suppliers. In this equation, Norway emerges as a key player.

Paul St-Pierre Plamondon's Quebec: between the dream of independence and reality

Quebec is experiencing a historic moment: Paul St-Pierre Plamondon and the Parti Québécois were swept to power in the October 2026 elections. To mark the occasion, "Objectif monde" looks back at the history of the former New France and travels to Quebec's forgotten regions: Tête-à-la-Baleine, Val-d'Or, Chibougamau, Chicoutimi.

Guests: Stéphan Bureau, journalist and host; Raoul Delcorde, former Belgian ambassador to Canada, professor of international relations at Université Laval in Quebec City; Maxime Corneau, Radio-Canada journalist

Presented by: Dominique Laresche
